title: Vela reference artifact manifest v1 (contract C7)
description: Per-case inventory of Sentaurus reference artifacts that stay outside the public repository (plan section 12). The manifest is committed as reference_tcad/<case>/artifact_manifest.json and an identical copy lives next to the archived files. Hashes describe the archived copies only: TDR files embed timestamps, so a rerun of the same deck produces different hashes. Reproducibility is expressed by producer.cmd_sha256 + sentaurus_version + the structural summary, not by the artifact hash.

version.description: Archive version sub-directory (v1, v2, ...). Registered files are immutable; regenerated artifacts go to a new version.

host.description: ssh: alias from the user's ssh config (sentaurus).

root.description: ssh/local: absolute root directory; content_addressed: URL or path of the sha256/ tree; github_release: owner/repo.

sentaurus_version.description: Version banner from the _des.log header, e.g. T-2022.03-SP2 (0.7745337).

deck_matches_repository.description: True when every producer cmd equals the corresponding reference_tcad/<case>/source file after stripping comments and collapsing whitespace (plan section 12.4 check 2); byte equality is not required because Workbench re-indents decks. False cases (different physics or settings, substituted placeholders, transposed mesh) are fixtures or partial references and are excluded from the plan section 8 acceptance.

vm_run_directory.description: Directory the files were copied from (provenance only, may no longer exist).

path.description: Relative path inside <root>/<case>/<version>/; the first component is the category directory.

category.description: A source, B curve (.plt), C mesh, D field (_des.tdr), E log (plan table 12.1).

cmd.description: Command file (basename) that produced the artifact.

cmd_sha256.description: LF-normalised hash of that command file (same rule as execution IR source.sha256).

summary.description: Structural summary extracted at registration; keys depend on the category.

datasets.description: .plt data group names or TDR field names.

bias_V.description: _des.tdr: electrode voltages of the plotted state when known.

exit_status.description: _des.log: final line class (Good Bye / error text).
